actions.action: Enforce format eligibility on the server
actions.mechanism: Creation requires the flag and declared format support; opening requires support for the document's stored format.
actions.implementation: Authorize each request, inspect the document format, and reject unsupported opens using existing client-compatible errors before returning content.
actions.check: Test flag-on and flag-off creation across both binaries; verify old clients never receive new-format payloads.
actions.risk: Declarations can be inaccurate; default missing capabilities to legacy-only.

actions.action: Keep previously readable documents in the legacy format
actions.mechanism: Prevent incompatible in-place migration so old clients retain access to the same document and its ongoing compatible edits.
actions.implementation: Reject new-only features on legacy documents. Offer explicit creation of a separately identified new-format copy, preserving the original, permissions, and links.
actions.check: An old client reopens the original after copying and after subsequent compatible edits without parser failures.
actions.risk: Separate copies diverge; clearly identify their independent histories.

actions.action: Separate creation rollback from existing-document support
actions.mechanism: The rollout flag controls new-format creation, not retention or the decoder needed for existing new documents.
actions.implementation: On rollback, disable creation and new-format writes; retain authorized reads for capable clients. Keep new documents and compatible reader infrastructure intact.
actions.check: Create a new document, roll back, and verify unchanged content remains readable while writes and new creation fail explicitly.
actions.risk: Binary rollback must retain a compatible reader service.

actions.action: Scope capability caches to the requesting installation
actions.mechanism: Account-wide or stale capability entries must not authorize an older binary to receive an unsupported document format.
actions.implementation: Bind declarations to authenticated installation sessions and capability revisions. Key caches accordingly; reject mismatches and treat absent declarations as legacy-only.
actions.check: Seed an account cache with new capabilities, then connect its old binary; verify new-format access is rejected and legacy reads succeed.
actions.risk: A consistently false declaration cannot prove actual parser support.

actions.mechanism: Server-side operation validation prevents newer collaborators from inserting unsupported constructs into a legacy document, including through stale sessions.
actions.implementation: Check every edit against the stored format and write policy before committing or broadcasting. Return explicit rejection rather than dropping unsupported fields.
actions.check: Run simultaneous old/new collaborators: compatible edits converge, new-only edits fail atomically, and the old client reconnects and parses the document.
actions.risk: Offline edits need visible rejection and recovery, not silent loss.

actions.action: Commit format metadata and content atomically
actions.mechanism: Transactional publication prevents readers from observing a new-format payload labeled as legacy or a partially created document.
actions.implementation: Stage content durably; atomically publish its format, content reference, and permissions after rechecking creation policy. Make retries idempotent.
actions.check: Inject crashes and rollback between staging and publication; verify no mislabeled documents, duplicate creations, or loss of committed content.
actions.risk: Garbage collection must distinguish abandoned staging data from committed documents.
